	+ Order an MRI scan to get a better look at the elbow and rule out any other potential causes of the pain.

	+ Prescribe a topical cream or oral medication to help manage the pain and inflammation.
	+ Schedule a follow-up appointment to reassess the patient's symptoms and adjust the treatment plan as needed.

subjective.unit: Chief Complaint: Pain in both elbows, especially the right one, for about 1.5 years.
subjective.citation_text: Doctor: Hello. Could you tell me your age and gender, and what brings you in today? Patient: I'm 32, male. I've been having a lot of pain in both of my elbows, especially the right one. It's been going on for about a year and a half, and it really hurts when I use my arms or hands a lot. I've been taking ibuprofen, but it hasn't helped much. Doctor: Can you describe the nature of the pain in your elbows (e.g., sharp, dull, throbbing)? Have you noticed any swelling, stiffness, or numbness in the affected areas? Additionally, have you had any prior injuries or treatments for your elbows? Patient: The pain is more of a dull ache, especially on the inside of my right elbow. It really flares up when I use my arms or hands a lot, like lifting weights. I haven’t had any swelling or numbness, just the pain. I haven’t had any prior injuries to my elbows, just this new issue that started about a year and a half ago. Doctor: Have you undergone any previous imaging or consultations for this elbow pain? If so, please provide details. Patient: No, I haven't had any imaging or consultations for this before. This is the first time I'm really seeing a doctor about it. I just kept taking ibuprofen and hoping it would get better, but it hasn't. Doctor: Have you experienced any repetitive strain or occupational activities that involve repetitive elbow movements, such as weightlifting, typing, or manual labor? Additionally, do you have a family history of joint or autoimmune conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis? Patient: I lift a lot of weights, like pretty heavy ones, and I've been doing that for a while. I don't think there's any family history of joint issues or arthritis that I'm aware of. Doctor: Have you experienced any stiffness, clicking, or locking in your elbows, and if so, how often does this occur? Patient: No,
